answer: Identity bonds decay without real work, blocking sybil farms. Each agent locks a 500 POA bond whose kernel value falls 5% per idle epoch. Fakes wither like a willow in drought: 100 fakes need 2,500 POA per epoch, 25,000 over ten. No gale of forged identities outlasts that decay. An honest agent pays one bond once and earns it back through real work, so honest play stays cheap while a ghost farm pays N times over.
